description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח לרכב
description.summary: This table details the conditions for towing services as part of a car insurance policy. It outlines the circumstances under which towing is covered, limitations on location, and requirements for vehicle operability.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי שירותי הגרירה הכלולים בפוליסת ביטוח לרכב. השירותים כוללים גרירה בכל רחבי מדינת ישראל, למעט אזורי השטחים והרצועה, בתנאים מסוימים כמו מצב מכני לא תקין או תאונת דרכים. גרירה ניתנת כאשר ספק השירות אינו יכול להתניע את הרכב או לבצע תיקון במקום. תנאי הפוליסה מגדירים גם מה נחשב ל״כביש״ לצורך שירותי גרירה. שירותי גרירה ניתנים בתנאי שיש גישה ישירה לרכב השירות. תנאים אלו חלים על פוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון.
notable_values: Towing location: State of Israel (excluding Autonomy and Gaza Strip)
Extraction distance: up to 20m from the road
Road definition: asphalt or paved road, 2X4 drive travel, organized parking
product_hints: פוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון

sketch:
2.4 Towing the vehicle which is entitled to the service (hereinafter the "vehicle") shall be subject to the following conditions :
2.4.1 Towing shall be from any place in the State of Israel to any place in the State of Israel, except to the areas of the Autonomy and Gaza Strip, subject to paragraph 2.3 above.
2.4.2 There is a need to tow the vehicle as a result of the vehicle being inoperable as a result of a road accident, mechanical malfunction emanating from the vehicle which requires laying-up the vehicle, or theft.
2.4.3 The service provider is unable to start the vehicle or to perform a roadside repair on site, or to provide first aid.
2.4.4 The vehicle is on a road and may be towed immediately by a standard towing vehicle suitable for electric vehicles at the sole discretion of the service provider. For the purpose of this conditions, "a road" shall mean an asphalt or paved road or travel of vehicles with 2X4 drive, an organized parking area or private parking space which is uncovered and allows direct access with a tow truck.
2.4.5 Extraction of the vehicle -minor extractions from sites nearby a road following a road accident, (up to 20m from the road) provided that the duration of the extraction shall not exceed 20 minutes and may be performed by means of a tow truck suitable for electric vehicles without assistance of other tow trucks or auxiliary tools.
Extraction emanating from any other reason, including sinking of the vehicle shall be provided against payment, with a discount on the service provider's price list.
2.4.6 The towing services will be provided on condition that direct access is available for the service vehicle.
